summary: Comprehensive testing of Labs & Imaging feature on New Visit page completed. All 11 backend tests passed and all frontend features verified working. The Labs & Imaging section is correctly positioned between Vitals and SOAP Notes, displays existing patient attachments as messenger-style teal bubbles, and integrates seamlessly with the visit form.
passed_tests: Labs & Imaging section appears on New Visit page with correct position (after Vitals, before SOAP Notes)
File count badge shows correct number (6)
Messenger-style teal bubbles display existing lab/imaging files for the patient
Upload controls present: file input, tag selector (Lab Result/X-Ray/Ultrasound/ECG), notes input, send button
Clicking on image opens zoom/pan viewer modal
Zoom/pan viewer has zoom in/out buttons, slider, reset, fit, and download controls
Edit button (pencil icon) opens inline edit form for filename/tag/notes
Edit form shows pre-filled values and has Cancel/Save buttons
Delete button present for each file
Save Visit works correctly with Labs section present (form submission not broken)
Visit saved successfully navigates to Visit Details page
Vitals section still functions properly
SOAP Notes section still functions properly
AI assist buttons (AI Convert to SOAP, Suggest, Generate) have type='button' - don't break form
Labs uploaded from New Visit page show in patient profile Labs & Imaging tab
All data-testid attributes correctly prefixed with 'visit-lab-*' for New Visit page
Backend: List attachments returns data without file_data (performance optimized)
Backend: Get single attachment returns full data including file_data for viewing
Backend: Upload, Update (filename/tag/notes), Delete operations work correctly
Backend: Unauthorized requests correctly rejected
Backend: Visit creation API still works after Labs section added
critical_code_review_comments: Buttons inside Labs & Imaging section have type='button' to prevent form submission - good practice
Image viewer modal uses Dialog component outside the form to avoid nested form issues
File list uses max-height with overflow-y-auto for scrollable area within card
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes with 'visit-lab-*' prefix
Edit form replaces bubble inline with bordered card - clean UX
Upload bar positioned at bottom with border-t separator - clean layout

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Labs & Imaging features verified working on New Visit page)

seed_data_creation: Used existing 6 test attachments from previous iterations. Created 2 new test visits during testing.
